notes.title: The Alpha Playtest has been EXTENDED ✨
notes.notes: [p]BIG NEWS![/p][p][/p][p]🚨 We’re extending our Alpha Playtest! 🚨[/p][p][/p][p]Now you’ve got until [b]September 22[/b] to hop into our Discord and show off your haul-building and defending skills 💪🐰 Plus, it’s extra time to share your feedback so we can keep making the game even better 💚[/p][p][/p][p][url="https://discord.com/invite/E9kheX7puq"][u]Join us on Discord[/u][/url], and select the “Interested” role, to get your Steam key to playtest! 🥕✨[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44514748/00b866d8e5da2b1dafb169965474566b46dd6c9b.png"][/img][/p][p][b]As a reminder, this is what is new for this Alpha Playtest:[/b][/p][p][/p][list][*][p]the town, quests, exploring, new weapons, roguelite cards from the last playtest[/p][/*][*][p]New Tutorial Pop-ups 📜[/p][/*][*][p]New Difficulty Modes (Easy & Normal) ⚔️[/p][/*][*][p]A new Enemy and Tower 🦝[/p][/*][*][p]Controller Support! 🎮[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][b]Plus a bunch of improvements, balances, and bug fixes:[/b][/p][list][*][p]Fixed overselling issue in the shop 🛒[/p][/*][*][p]Delivery Truck now requires the right amount of gold 💰[/p][/*][*][p]Sell basket resets correctly 🧺[/p][/*][*][p]Sniper Violet now unlocks the correct evolution 🌸[/p][/*][*][p]Item sprite display bugs have been cleaned up 🎨[/p][/*][*][p]Typos from last playtest polished up ✏️[/p][/*][*][p]UI for planting seeds feels smoother 🌱[/p][/*][*][p]Improved overall performance for smoother runs 🎮[/p][/*][*][p]Balance tweaks based on your feedback 💌 [/p][p][/p][/*][/list][p][b]We are also fixing and adding new things to the build during the playtest such as:[/b][/p][list][*][p]Low health indicator when the player is low on health[/p][/*][*][p]Low haul content indicator when raccoons are stealing crops and when the player is below 3 crops[/p][/*][*][p]Resolution selector in the options menu[/p][/*][/list][p]To learn more about the Alpha Playtest, check out our last post: [/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/2514330/view/539990024660190978?l=english"][/dynamiclink][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44514748/00b866d8e5da2b1dafb169965474566b46dd6c9b.png"][/img][/p][p]We’ve seen so many new faces in this playtest, and we can’t thank you enough for hopping in! Watching everyone play, have fun, and share feedback has been incredible, and it’s all helping us make The Rabbit Haul the best it can be.[/p][p][/p][p]The fun’s not over yet! [u][url="https://discord.com/invite/E9kheX7puq"]Join our Discord [/url][/u]for another whole week of playtesting, and let us know how many runs you get accomplished 🌟[/p][p][/p][p]Until next time 👋[/p]

notes.title: Get Ready for our next Alpha Playtest! 🐰✨
notes.notes:
[h3]UPDATE: PLAYTEST IS RUNNING UNTIL SEPT. 22![/h3][p][/p][p]Hello again! 👋

We have another Alpha Playtest on the horizon, and thanks to your feedback, it's better than ever!

But before we get into it, check out our newest trailer if you haven’t! [/p][previewyoutube="q_yu9bAlgDk;full"][/previewyoutube][p] [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44514748/00b866d8e5da2b1dafb169965474566b46dd6c9b.png"][/img][b]We want you! 
[/b]Playtests are the heart of how we make The Rabbit Haul the best it can be. Every bit of feedback, bug report, and idea you share is looked through and helps us grow and improve.

[b]When and where?
[/b]The playtest takes place from [b]September 8th to the 15th[/b], giving you a whole week to test and enjoy the game, WOO! 

[b]How to participate?
[/b]To participate, you need to [url="discord.gg/E9kheX7puq"]join our community Discord [/url]and choose the interested role. Everyone with the interested role will receive a Steam key via Discord DM the day the playtest starts, and will be able to redeem it on Steam to download The Rabbit Haul.

There will be more instructions for you in the Discord, so hop on in to be ready to jump into The Rabbit Haul! If you can't make this one, no problem. We have more planned down the road!

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44514748/00b866d8e5da2b1dafb169965474566b46dd6c9b.png"][/img][b]What’s new for this playtest?
[/b]
All the fun from the last playtest is back (the town, quests, exploring, new weapons, roguelite cards), PLUS some new updates from your feedback on the last playtest:

[b]New Tutorial Pop-ups[/b]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44514748/f58f44154717db2087fef2e42ed8a4fc0d1aa07f.jpg"][/img]We’ve added new tutorial pop-ups to guide you through key mechanics. Whether you’re brand new or just need a refresher, these tips will make it easier to understand how to build a strong garden!

[b] New difficulty modes (Easy & Normal) [/b]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44514748/1c457fb46134b1eba2ea61c85afec5bba047d93e.png"][/img]Sometimes you just want to relax in the garden, and sometimes you want to test your limits. Now you can choose between Easy and Normal modes to best suit how you want to play!  [b]New Enemy and Tower[/b] [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44514748/f01094d3f1962e036a841f85e181daa83b115c04.png"][/img]Take on the new [b]Reaper level 2[/b], and try out the new [b]Giant Stink Bomb[/b] on the rest of the Trash Panda Posse! (We can’t wait to see how you use it)

[b]Controller support[/b]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44514748/99c5eb6f7ffaf614f9a9db598e9bcd66808460a2.png"][/img]Controller support has been fixed!  Xbox layouts are supported for now, with more to come in the future.

[b]Improvements/Balancing/Bug Fixes[/b][/p][list][*][p]Fixed overselling issue in the shop 🛒 [/p][/*][*][p]Delivery Truck now requires the right amount of gold 💰[/p][/*][*][p] Sell basket resets correctly 🧺 [/p][/*][*][p]Sniper Violet now unlocks the correct evolution 🌸 [/p][/*][*][p]Item sprite display bugs have been cleaned up 🎨[/p][/*][*][p] Typos from last playtest polished up ✏️ [/p][/*][*][p]UI for planting seeds feels smoother 🌱 [/p][/*][*][p]Improved overall performance for smoother runs 🎮 [/p][/*][*][p]Balance tweaks based on your feedback 💌  [/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44514748/00b866d8e5da2b1dafb169965474566b46dd6c9b.png"][/img]As always, we are so grateful to have this community here with us as we continue to build our game. We look forward to sharing this latest playtest with you, so make sure you [url="discord.gg/E9kheX7puq"]join our Discord[/url] to take part, and feel free to invite your friends to spread the word! ✨

Until next time 👋
[/p]

notes.title: Over 12,000 Raccoons Were Defeated… 🦝💥
notes.notes: [p]We’re back with this month’s newsletter, and this one’s all about our latest playtest![/p][p][/p][p]From July 25 to August 5, our Discord community got exclusive early access to the newest version of The Rabbit Haul. And wow… y’all did not hold back![/p][p][/p][p]Our server has been hopping with bug reports, awesome suggestions, epic run stats, and some truly wild raccoon-slaying numbers. It’s been amazing to see your reactions in real time and to have you right there with us. 🐇💚[/p][p][/p][p]Here are some highlights from the chaos:[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44514748/9eaf5bb1ef1767dccbcca217f8a2e9ea66de0d7a.png"][/img][/p][p]A screenshot of a player's win stats! ✨[/p][p][/p][h2]📊 Playtest by the numbers:[/h2][list][*][p]142 runs were played[/p][/*][*][p]457 chests opened[/p][/*][*][p]6 victories by defeating all waves (MVPs, where you at?👀)[/p][/*][*][p]23 victories by ordering Gerald’s Delivery Service[/p][/*][*][p]55 homes rebuilt in Town[/p][/*][*][p]7,767 Symbiosis Crystals collected[/p][/*][*][p]23,935 blades of grass mowed down[/p][/*][*][p]12,832 raccoons met their match 🦝💥[/p][p][/p][/*][/list][h2]🌱 Player choices:[/h2][list][*][p]76% of all crops planted were Strawberries (3243) 🍓[/p][/*][*][p]Most-planted tower? Touch Me Not at 59% (815), followed by Power Flower at 20% (277)[/p][/*][*][p]Most-picked Roguelite Card? Beehive at 9% (40) 🐝[/p][/*][*][p]Most common symbiotic relationship: Sprinkler at 46% (66), with Beehive close behind at 38% (55)[/p][/*][*][p]Most popular Town shop upgrade? Power Flower at 26% of all upgrades (106 upgrades purchased in total)[/p][p][/p][/*][/list][h2]⏱ Total time played:[/h2][p]You all logged a whopping [b]79 hours and 48 minutes[/b] of gameplay in just 12 days! 😮[/p][p][/p][h2]⭐ Player ratings:[/h2][list][*][p]52.2% gave the game 4 stars[/p][/*][*][p]26.1% gave it 5 stars[/p][p][/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44514748/0b09fd3a61be316218d0b66b479d7a43f79d3823.png"][/img][/p][p]A playtester's impressive garden defenses! 💥[/p][p][/p][h2]🚧 A glimpse at what is next:[/h2][p]Your feedback is gold, and here’s what came up the most at first glance:[/p][list][*][p]Lack of controller support (yep, we’re already fixing that)[/p][/*][*][p]Difficulty curve (we’ll look at adding an easy mode)[/p][/*][*][p]Missing indicators for low health/low haul (those surprise losses hurt)[/p][/*][*][p]Some mechanics are not clearly explained (Delivery Truck, Symbiosis Crystals/XP)[/p][/*][*][p]Plus, 44 bugs were reported which are logged and ready to be prioritized for our team to tackle! 💥🐞[/p][/*][/list][p]Rest assured that we read through all the bug reports, feature suggestions and survey responses we receive. We might not get to your bug or suggestions right away, but we will eventually.[/p][p][/p][h2]🌱  How you can support us[/h2][list][*][p]Join our [u][url="https://discord.com/invite/UVDt2ScaDJ"]Discord[/url][/u] to be first in line for the next playtest and get all the latest updates.[/p][/*][*][p]Wishlist [u][url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/2514330/The_Rabbit_Haul/"]The Rabbit Haul on Steam[/url][/u] –  it’s one of the best ways to help our game reach more players![/p][p][/p][/*][/list][p]We can’t thank you enough for playing, testing, and helping us grow the game. Your support makes every day worth it for our team. 💛[/p][p][/p][p]Stay tuned for details on the next playtest![/p][p][/p][p]Until next time! 👋[/p]

notes.title: Alpha Playtest is almost here!
notes.notes:
[p]Hello! 👋[/p][p][/p][p]TOMORROW’S THE DAY! 🎉 The Rabbit Haul Alpha Playtest is about to begin, and we’re so ready for you to hop in![/p][p][/p][p]We are thrilled to share this playtest with you as it includes a BUNCH of new features we have been working on for the last six months! The playtest will run from [b]July 25th to August 1st[/b], giving you a full week to dig into new features, test out your strategies, and help us shape the future of The Rabbit Haul! [/p][p][/p][p][b]How do I participate?[/b][/p][olist][*][p]Join our Discord community! [url="https://discord.gg/E9kheX7puq"]https://discord.gg/E9kheX7puq[/url][/p][/*][*][p]When prompted, choose the [b]interested [/b]role. [/p][/*][*][p]If you have the Interested role, you’ll receive a Steam key via Discord DM on July 25th, which you can redeem to download the game.[/p][/*][*][p]The playtest survey will open once the playtest starts, so we can gather feedback and hear your thoughts! You can find the survey here: [url="https://forms.gle/oaJq31fiAFkJKU1B7"]https://forms.gle/oaJq31fiAFkJKU1B7[/url][/p][p][/p][/*][/olist][p][b]What's new for this playtest?[/b]
[/p][p]This playtest is packed with fresh features, including:[/p][p]🏘️ The Town[/p][p]📜 Quests[/p][p]🗺️ Exploration[/p][p]⚔️ New Weapons & Improved Combat[/p][p]🃏Roguelite Cards[/p][p]🎶New music[/p][p]🔨Bug fixes and MORE![/p][p][/p][p]Read more details about the new features in our last post: [/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/2514330/view/539983683367472907?l=english"][/dynamiclink][/p][p]Thank you in advance for your time, filling out our post-playtest survey, giving us feedback, and overall excitement. It means the world to our small team and keeps us inspired to make The Rabbit Haul the best it can be! 💚
[/p][p]More detailed instructions will be waiting for you in Discord, so hop in now to be ready for The first Rabbit Haul Alpha Playtest tomorrow! If you can't make this one, don’t worry, there will be more in the future. 🐰[/p][p][/p][p]May your carrots be plentiful and your towers strong! 🥕[/p]

notes.title: Playtests are BACK!
notes.notes:
[h3][b]* The playtest start date has been changed to July 25[/b][/h3][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44514748/00b866d8e5da2b1dafb169965474566b46dd6c9b.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]Welcome back to our monthly newsletter. This month we are excited to announce that playtests are BACK! Keep reading to know how to get involved and what to expect![/p][p][/p][p]This playtest is a BIG one because we’ve been working on a bunch of new features for the last 6 months, some of which we’ve been promising for years! This is also a huge milestone for us because The Rabbit Haul is finally hitting the [b]Alpha [/b]stage. [/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44514748/00b866d8e5da2b1dafb169965474566b46dd6c9b.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][b]We need your help![/b][/p][p]Playtests are SO important to make the game the best that it can be! Whether you are a seasoned veteran in our community, or have just joined, we are so thankful for your time and interest in playing the game, giving us feedback, suggesting features, submitting bug reports, and filling out surveys. It means a great deal to us and it truly motivates us to keep going! This next one will be the biggest yet, and we hope that you will take part in it in big numbers![/p][p][/p][p][b]When, What, How, Who and Where, you say?[/b][/p][p]The playtest is planned to start on July 25 and will be open for a whole week. YAY! To participate, you need to join our community [u][url="https://discord.gg/UVDt2ScaDJ"]Discord [/url][/u]and when prompted choose the [b]interested [/b]role. Everyone with the interested role will receive a Steam key by Discord DM on July 25, and will be able to redeem it on Steam to download The Rabbit Haul.[/p][p][/p][p]There will be more instructions for you in the Discord, so hop on in to be ready to jump in The Rabbit Haul on July 25! If you can't make this one, no problem, there will more in the future![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44514748/00b866d8e5da2b1dafb169965474566b46dd6c9b.png"][/img][/p][p]
[b]What’s new in the game?[/b][/p][p]As you might have read in our monthly updates, we’ve been hard at work on a lot of new features. So on July 25, you’ll be able to experience for the first time ever:[/p][p][/p][p][b]The Town[/b][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44514748/36d7740912cea6927cff1d062a0777434a6cd436.gif"][/img][/p][p]The new safe hub for our cute bunny protagonist and his friends! The Town has vendors to upgrade your defenses, NPCs, quests and will serve as the anchor point of the story as you rebuild the home of your neighbours to its former glory.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Quests[/b][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44514748/460f4cb5c1255167dd659591b5138868f126779b.gif"][/img][/p][p]We are testing out a new feature, Quests! You will be able to accept Quests from NPCs which will help you progress and offer amazing and sometimes exclusive rewards! It definitely pays to be a good neighbour 😀[/p][p][/p][p][b]Exploration[/b][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44514748/9ae777175fb28bd91a04966543f8bd44e72b4b28.gif"][/img][/p][p]The map just got BIGGER! We’ve added areas to discover during runs that will reward you for exploring your surroundings. The further you are in a run, the more you will be able to explore.[/p][p][/p][p][b]New Weapons & Improved Combat[/b]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44514748/bac4b1d1d2ae0cf89e5448de5b056c3dd6450c8c.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Combat got a lot more fun, with a much needed improvement on the feel of melee and range combat! You’ll also have an onslaught of new weapons to discover and master!
[/p][p][b]Roguelite Cards[/b][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44514748/4a69e22c9cf195e3e93b3217b01c52a6a26041d4.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Symbiosis crystals, a currency you collect when establishing and maintaining powerful synergies between your towers, will now provide you with items, special abilities and upgrades! The symbiosis crystals fill up an XP bar that when filled, gives you a choice between 3 rewards. Your gardening skills will surely pay dividends with this new feature. [/p][p][b]New Music[/b][/p][p]This new build will feature new custom music from the amazing [u][url="https://ashellinthepit.com/"]A Shell in the Pit[/url][/u]. Can’t wait for you all to groove to these new tracks![/p][p][b]And More[/b][/p][p]There’s so much more tweaks and polish that’s been added to the game, in fact, too many to list them all here. So you’ll have to play it next month to see it all in action. hehe[/p][p]Before then, we want to know which one of these are you most excited to try next month?[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44514748/00b866d8e5da2b1dafb169965474566b46dd6c9b.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]We’re thrilled to have you along for this exciting chapter in our journey! If you haven't already, please wishlist The Rabbit Haul on Steam, join us and invite your friends to our [url="https://discord.gg/UVDt2ScaDJ"]Discord [/url]to playtest the game! [/p][p] [/p][p]– Until next time 👋[/p][p]
[/p]

notes.title: You Asked for more Cozy - So we built a Town!
notes.notes:
Need a place to rest after a round of hauling crops? Looking to upgrade and unlock new towers and abilities? Want to relax with some cute critters? Then the Town is just for you!

Welcome back as this month we are sharing our latest big update: the Town! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44514748/0f541f6585deb571648e023e2217ac65794e1fbb.gif[/img]

[h3]The Town[/h3]
The Town is in ruins after a raid from the Trash Panda Posse. Aid the mayor and rebuild the Town from the ground up! Boost the morale of the townsfolk with the crops that you have hauled from your run. Doing so will unlock new features, new friendly critters, stores, towers and crops as the Town comes back to life!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44514748/00b866d8e5da2b1dafb169965474566b46dd6c9b.png[/img]

[h3]Art for the Town[/h3]
We had a lot of fun designing what the Town would look like. Take a sneak peak at some of the art. Here are a few sample concepts of Town assets!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44514748/626e3e450331cda6bf5f97ae680981779cd24c17.jpg[/img] [i]Town Asset concepts[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44514748/36d7740912cea6927cff1d062a0777434a6cd436.gif[/img]
[i]The Town in game[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44514748/27a5f2d512f01e27a653031e127ff017474b8cce.gif[/img]
[i]Enter a new run at the Town's exit gate[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44514748/00b866d8e5da2b1dafb169965474566b46dd6c9b.png[/img]

[h3]Quests?[/h3]
In the Town, you can talk, find and accept quests from townsfolk. Discover how you can be of help. There's much to do in this rebuilding season!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44514748/8933b72ccc5c04ac77a84d52b50e8f155d9b11dc.gif[/img]
[i]Gerald's store is in ruins! Will you help him get it up and running?[/i]

Additionally, we are introducing our dialogue system. Now you can interact and talk with other friendly animals!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44514748/74dd1ad8f4ad1445d50456df742967d794f93587.gif[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44514748/fb69207be144bca948296e81a6b1bac2cbb68310.gif[/img]
[i]Aid in rebuilding houses for the villagers[/i]

[h3]Quest Tracking[/h3]
We are currently building a method to track quests. Here is a concept of the Journal, a feature that will allow you to keep track of what quests you are working towards and quests that you have finished.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44514748/907fac47fb66c08ff3d388caef3af045d085c9a9.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44514748/00b866d8e5da2b1dafb169965474566b46dd6c9b.png[/img]

[h3]Thanks for reading[/h3]
There's still lots for us to develop in the town, but we can’t wait to let you guys try it out! If you haven't already please wishlist The Rabbit Haul and be on the lookout for our next playtest coming soon. 

Until next time! 👋

notes.title: You Asked, We Swung — The Rabbit Haul’s Combat Just Leveled Up 🐇⚔️
notes.notes:
All hands on deck as we continue the development of The Rabbit Haul. Lots of progress is being made behind the scenes and we are waiting for the right time to reveal all the work that has been done so far! For now, let's talk about the changes we made to the combat!

[i]Please excuse the low quality GIFS. If someone knows how to import better quality GIFS into Steam do let us know![/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44514748/00b866d8e5da2b1dafb169965474566b46dd6c9b.png[/img]

[h3]Combat Redesign[/h3]

We’ve been eager to polish the combat system in our game. Based on your feedback during the playtest it was something we knew you would appreciate as well. In the beginning, it was a necessity to develop a simple combat system that acted as a foundation for us to develop other features. Now, we are ready to push our combat to the next level!

[b]Old Sword Attacks[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44514748/17385fba5db628f46c858666c32ef4cd58924396.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44514748/57e68d05c6a7e479733e3c1890bc0bae3481b697.gif[/img]

[b]New Sword Attack[/b]

The new system implements a few techniques to add a feeling of weight and feedback. We are also allowing players to have access to combo slashes without needing to buy it from Pauline in-run.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44514748/030a7085a7bd9da0fe59850376b2f3c5013a746e.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44514748/1e1946724c527c858b90a8a3c6917738116adfd7.gif[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44514748/00b866d8e5da2b1dafb169965474566b46dd6c9b.png[/img]

[h3]Camera Work[/h3]

A subtle yet effective polish we added was a camera sway. Before, the camera would move with the player one for one. Now, the camera feels reactive to your movements as the camera follows with a slight delay. It's a small change but it adds a layer of refinement we were looking for.

[b]Old Camera: No Sway Effect[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44514748/c10f7764940714e514503101dcbb21f6db6fd18a.gif[/img]

[b]New Camera: Sway Effect[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44514748/a2449ea5bd322191eb041c1d456f0b87a1f33871.gif[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44514748/00b866d8e5da2b1dafb169965474566b46dd6c9b.png[/img]

[h3]Screen Shake[/h3]

Additionally, with our new camera set up we are able to test different effects like screen shake to really sell a heavy attack! This is still a work in progress and as you can see this feature requires a gentle touch.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44514748/fe50e94bc7ccb030c664e8a98f237bbfcefd6238.gif[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44514748/00b866d8e5da2b1dafb169965474566b46dd6c9b.png[/img]

[h3]Weapons[/h3]

It's been our goal to implement an array of exciting new weapons that promote discovery and highlight different playstyles. We are eagerly designing and testing them out and we are so excited to get it into your hands soon. For now, here's a quick tease at some new weapon concepts!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44514748/bac4b1d1d2ae0cf89e5448de5b056c3dd6450c8c.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44514748/729a2ac551851fb035453b40a0a8f24c55f21c1d.gif[/img]

Have an idea for a weapon you’d love to see? Join us in our [url=https://discord.com/invite/UVDt2ScaDJ]Discord[/url] and share your ideas with us and our community

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44514748/00b866d8e5da2b1dafb169965474566b46dd6c9b.png[/img]

Thanks so much for your continued support for The Rabbit Haul. We can’t wait to share more as we work hard to create an experience you will enjoy! 

As always please Wishlist The Rabbit Haul on Steam if you haven't already, and we will catch you next month!

notes.title: Our Most Requested Feature Is In: Planting Pots
notes.notes:
One of the most requested features we have received from our community is the ability to move plants after you have already planted them. We are excited to announce our new feature, Pots. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44514748/943149504912baa1c7632063560074a35b0f2079.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44514748/00b866d8e5da2b1dafb169965474566b46dd6c9b.png[/img]

[h3]Reposition your Plants[/h3]
Got a Crop growing out of range of your Support Tower? Want to reposition a Tower to optimize its offensive abilities? Or do you simply want to redecorate and beautify your garden? We got you covered! Pots allow you to pick up a Crop or a Tower and reposition them to your liking! You can pick up any tower or crop at any stage of growth! Though you cannot pot a Structure based Tower like the Beehive or the Sprinkler. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44514748/4a4bf8f1055e9882636882c83d6008be1b33f5c3.jpg[/img]

[h3]Durability[/h3]
Be aware, each Pot has a limited amount of uses before they break! Strategize when to use your precious Pots to maximize the potential of your garden!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44514748/5beec3f4afec9d82d7def088bbe3291238cd2490.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44514748/711474867e4e1b5d093a89e4c2e8c7c4d72be834.jpg[/img]

[h3]Big Thanks![/h3]
We would like to thank our community for helping us build the game you want to play! Are you liking what you are seeing? Do you have any other feature requests? Let us Know and keep updated with the community at our [url=https://discord.gg/UVDt2ScaDJ]Discord![/url]

Last but not least, wishlist the game to stay in the know for any future playtests!

The team has been working on a handful of new features that we are excited to share with you all soon, we hope to catch you in the next feature announcement!

notes.title: Raccoon Problem? Sniper Violet’s Got You Covered!
notes.notes:
We’ve added a new tower to The Rabbit Haul, and it’s a goody. The Sniper Violet is a tower that perfectly embodies the idea of beauty meeting precision. With its sharpshooting capabilities and the ability to give players the power of sight, the Sniper Violet is a formidable ally in your defense as it will ensure that no enemy is out of reach.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44514748/00b866d8e5da2b1dafb169965474566b46dd6c9b.png[/img]

[h3]Inspiration[/h3]

The Sniper Violet draws inspiration from the real-life violet flower, native to our home and known for its beauty and delicate scent. Violets are unique in how they disperse their seeds—by shooting them with remarkable precision, ensuring their growth in diverse environments. Similarly, the Sniper Violet tower excels at targeting enemies with pinpoint accuracy from afar. Its graceful yet deadly nature makes it a perfect homage to the violet flower's own strength and beauty.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44514748/fc58459c62a4f9bbfaa90085581909a442ec9b12.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44514748/00b866d8e5da2b1dafb169965474566b46dd6c9b.png[/img]

[h2]Sniper Violet Stages[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44514748/af06a82711b93faf387957bc64e585b201445608.png[/img]

[h3]Seed Packet[/h3]

Once you’ve unlocked the Sniper Violet in the upgrade store, Gerald’s Green Shop will stock Sniper Violet seed packets for purchase in your run.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44514748/00b866d8e5da2b1dafb169965474566b46dd6c9b.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44514748/176255f72f4de13628d83b74f8c03aa8243a22fc.png[/img]

[h3]Level 1[/h3]

At this stage, the Sniper Violet cannot attack. You must water and protect it from harm for 2 nights before it will bloom and gain its sharpshooting abilities.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44514748/00b866d8e5da2b1dafb169965474566b46dd6c9b.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44514748/4e46db29d8607cb937a8b41079735e26597a2947.png[/img]

[h3]Level 2[/h3]

At this stage, the Sniper Violet will defend your farm from raccoons, excelling at shooting enemies from afar!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44514748/00b866d8e5da2b1dafb169965474566b46dd6c9b.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44514748/a45c2e555a98bd70c803db08b4eac76b064fa486.png[/img]

[h3]Level 3A[/h3]

The Sniper Violet is the first tower to offer 2 different final stages. The first one, the Mega Sniper, comes with a significant damage increase and the Shared Vision symbiosis effect.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44514748/ea4ad3df8ec2d73f022c7838dfcdaa92cbd40d18.png[/img]

The Shared Vision effect allows Sniper Violets (at level 2 and above) in direct horizontal or vertical line of sight to share their attack radius, allowing them to cover even more of the battlefield. Be careful, as planting crops or other towers in between this line of sight will break it!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44514748/005b72ded12daede5be3a2b9d8ba782627413640.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44514748/00b866d8e5da2b1dafb169965474566b46dd6c9b.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44514748/fabae34649b274fd5b4e412dbfccfb7b90b4dc8d.png[/img]

[h3]Level 3B[/h3]

The Camo Sniper has a lot to offer as well. It benefits from an attack speed boost and the ability to target the elusive Ghillie Raccoons. Additionally, the Camo Sniper grants other towers within a 3x3 area the Spotter effect.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44514748/7f847fed6ce8181b567eba2f7fd5fc9588c56625.png[/img]

The Spotter effect grants its benefactor the ability to also target Ghillie raccoons who are normally invisible to range towers. The effect also increases the towers' attack radius.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44514748/9afd4057c1c5b2c8694bcb5df9d9ff6aba98fc65.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44514748/00b866d8e5da2b1dafb169965474566b46dd6c9b.png[/img]

That’s it for the Sniper Violet! [url=https://discord.gg/UVDt2ScaDJ]Join our Discord[/url] community to learn more about all that we are working on for The Rabbit Haul.

And of course, if you haven’t already, wishlist The Rabbit Haul on Steam to stay updated on when the next playtest will happen.

Until next time! 👋

notes.title: Who are the Trash Panda Posse? 🦝
notes.notes:
The world of The Rabbit Haul is full of adorable yet devious raccoons, each with their own tricks to snatch your hard-earned crops! In this dev update, we’re introducing all the enemy types you’ll encounter in the game. Each raccoon brings a unique challenge, so knowing what to expect will be crucial to your success. Let’s take a look at these cunning critters!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44514748/00b866d8e5da2b1dafb169965474566b46dd6c9b.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44514748/eca8ca6d438884e9a6e06314034018cbebeb258a.png[/img]

[h2]Bandit[/h2]

The Bandit is the most common enemy type. These pesky raccoons will steal crops when they reach your haul. If the player gets too close, they’ll try to attack and maintain aggression for a few seconds before focusing back on the haul. Expect to see a lot of these troublemakers throughout your journey!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44514748/00b866d8e5da2b1dafb169965474566b46dd6c9b.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44514748/189d1b808f9074387d60afc15b1a7d9c403b862e.png[/img]

[h2]Ghillie[/h2]

The Ghillie raccoon is a master of stealth. These camouflaged bandits cannot be targeted by projectile-based towers, making them tricky to deal with. They will also evade the player if they get too close, making them resistant to melee combat as well. Like the Bandit, they steal crops when they reach the haul.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44514748/00b866d8e5da2b1dafb169965474566b46dd6c9b.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44514748/f775c6a4f5d7e0c009c8270f7002069081734cde.png[/img]

[h2]Reaper[/h2]

Reapers have a singular purpose: destruction. Their priority is to attack and destroy towers before they even think about stealing crops. If you rely heavily on defensive structures, these raccoons will be a serious threat to your farm’s security. Get to them before they destroy all your defenses and leave you vulnerable to the next wave of raccoons.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44514748/00b866d8e5da2b1dafb169965474566b46dd6c9b.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44514748/992e1b49639c6bbe8331957f32b832ec483e35d0.png[/img]

[h2]Feral[/h2]

Unlike other raccoons, the Feral does not attack the player or your towers. Instead, their goal is to reach the haul as quickly as possible and devour your crops on the spot. Unfortunately, once a Feral eats a crop, it’s gone for good—you won’t be able to recover it!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44514748/00b866d8e5da2b1dafb169965474566b46dd6c9b.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44514748/b8f0f2e7e18a98f292f3f6d9caf7e27ce26e0be4.png[/img]

[h2]Bandit Level 2[/h2]

A stronger and more dangerous version of the regular Bandit, this upgraded thief has increased health and deals more damage. Expect a tougher fight when these raccoons come prowling!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44514748/00b866d8e5da2b1dafb169965474566b46dd6c9b.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44514748/4aedbb283af50d56f06df684d8edf1c58ab6f3cc.png[/img]

[h2]Wizard (Coming Soon!)[/h2]

The Wizard raccoon isn’t in the game yet, but when it arrives, it will be a major threat. This mystical menace will have different spells and tricks up its sleeve to take down your defenses and give the trash panda posse the edge!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44514748/00b866d8e5da2b1dafb169965474566b46dd6c9b.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44514748/367e462bec1ad57233b76eca3121b6ab2541fc59.png[/img]

[h2]Giant Bandit[/h2]

Slow but incredibly dangerous, the Giant Bandit is a walking disaster. If it reaches the haul, it will steal a LOT of crops in one go! This tanky raccoon also has a powerful AOE stomp attack (coming soon). With a massive health pool, defeating it won’t be easy.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44514748/00b866d8e5da2b1dafb169965474566b46dd6c9b.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44514748/0651d67e9361acf21347e809f12f1681d2964c81.png[/img]

[h2]Raccoon King[/h2]

The ultimate challenge, the Raccoon King is a boss that relentlessly chases the player. This powerful enemy has multiple unique abilities, but we’re keeping the details under wraps… for now. Expect a tough battle!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44514748/00b866d8e5da2b1dafb169965474566b46dd6c9b.png[/img]

That’s the full lineup of the Trash Panda Posse currently planned for the demo of The Rabbit Haul! Each raccoon brings a unique challenge, and we’d love to hear your thoughts. [url=https://discord.gg/UVDt2ScaDJ]Join our Discord[/url] community to share feedback and propose new enemy types in our feature request polls.

And of course, if you haven’t already, wishlist The Rabbit Haul on Steam to stay updated on development and be ready for the next playtest.

Until next time and watch out for those raccoons! 👋

notes.title: 🐰 December Playtest Recap: What we learned from our latest playtest
notes.notes:
[h1]Playtest Results, Exciting Updates, and What’s Next[/h1]

Hi everyone,

Happy New Year from all of us at Caldera Interactive! We’re starting 2025 with a look back at the December playtest for The Rabbit Haul. It was an incredible week, with over 70 players testing new features, submitting feedback, and helping us shape the future of the game.

Thank you for joining us on this journey. Here’s what we learned, what we’re working on, and how you can continue to be part of the process.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44514748/00b866d8e5da2b1dafb169965474566b46dd6c9b.png[/img]

[h2]What You Loved[/h2]

[list]
[*] Art Style: The cute visuals stood out as a highlight, with many players praising the vibrant look of the game.
[*] Engaging Gameplay: The mix of farming, tower defense, and combat kept players entertained and eager for more.
[*] Sniper Violet: This new tower addition was well-received and proved to be a favorite among testers.
[*] Extended Inventory: Players appreciated the added organization and flexibility this brought to gameplay.
[*] Community Events & Interactions: The live Q&A during the playtest was a hit, with players enjoying the chance to connect with the developers and share ideas, and also chatting strategies with other playtesters in the Discord. Want to join the fun? [url=https://discord.gg/SmvrWxP5jc]Join our Discord[/url].
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44514748/00b866d8e5da2b1dafb169965474566b46dd6c9b.png[/img]

[h2]What Needs Work[/h2]

[list]
[*] Combat Challenges: Combat was the most commonly mentioned area for improvement. Issues with hitboxes, weapon upgrades, and interactions between players and enemies made combat feel less polished.
[*] New Features Feedback: Stink Bombs: Players liked the concept but noted odd hitboxes behaviour and limited effectiveness during later waves.
[*] Sprinklers: While useful in theory, these were often replaced by Beehives, which provided more value for their cost.
[*] Controls and Accessibility: We received a few reports asking for more flexibility around remapping controls to make the game more accessible.
[*] Bugs: Playtesters submitted 51 bug reports, ranging from small UI issues to gameplay mechanics. We’ve already started working on fixes to address these for the next playtest.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44514748/00b866d8e5da2b1dafb169965474566b46dd6c9b.png[/img]

[h2]Who Played[/h2]

This playtest brought in many new players—73% were first-timers, introduced through events like Gamescom, word-of-mouth, and social media.

Our audience’s favorite genres, including Survival and RPGs, align well with The Rabbit Haul’s design. It’s exciting to see how well the game resonates with its intended audience.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44514748/00b866d8e5da2b1dafb169965474566b46dd6c9b.png[/img]

[h2]Community Highlights[/h2]

We love hearing your ideas! In our Discord, players can suggest new game features and vote on others’ submissions through our Feature Leaderboard. The top three suggestions right now are:

[olist]
[*] Ranged enemies (and more explosions) with 8 votes.
[*] Ability to destroy or move plants and towers with 7 votes.
[*] The ability to pet the pig with 6 votes. 🐷
[/olist]

These suggestions not only inspire us but also help us prioritize what’s most important to you. Want to share your ideas or vote on your favorites? [url=https://discord.gg/SmvrWxP5jc]Join our Discord[/url] to participate!

We also hosted a live Q&A session during the playtest, answering questions and diving deeper into The Rabbit Haul’s development. Thank you to everyone who joined and participated—it was a fantastic discussion! If you missed it, you can watch the recording on YouTube: Live Q&A Session.

[previewyoutube=ZrX-D3rJb9w;full][/previewyoutube]

We’re planning to host more live Q&As in the future, so stay tuned for announcements!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44514748/00b866d8e5da2b1dafb169965474566b46dd6c9b.png[/img]

[h2]What's Next[/h2]

Based on your feedback and our roadmap, we’re focusing on the following features and fixes for the next playtest:

[list]
[*] Boss Fight: Get ready for an epic challenge! The next playtest will introduce The Rabbit Haul’s first boss fight, adding a new layer of excitement and strategy to the game. Will your defenses be enough to take it down?
[*] Symbiosis Crystals: These will reward players for creating symbiotic relationships in their gardens, encouraging creative and strategic layouts.
[*] Haul Upgrades: Symbiosis Crystals will also unlock Haul Upgrades, letting you customize your strategy. These upgrades will add a new dimension to how you approach each run.
[*] Safe Zone Town: We’re replacing the current main menu upgrade store with a safe zone town. Between runs, you’ll be able to upgrade towers, manage your resources, and prepare for the challenges ahead. This immersive addition will deepen the game’s roguelite elements and give players more reasons to keep coming back.
[*] UI Updates: We’re continuing to refine the user experience with UI improvements such as the HUD.
[*] Custom Music: We will be working with a composer to bring fresh sounds to the game!
[*] Ability to Move Plants and Towers: Based on your feedback, we’re adding this highly requested feature to make gameplay more flexible and strategic.
[*] Balancing: Tweaking towers, crops, waves, and upgrades to be more fun and accessible.
[*] Bug Fixes: We’re actively addressing the 51 bug reports submitted during the last playtest to ensure a smoother experience.
[/list]

Unfortunately, we can’t get to everything for the next playtest. We love reading all your experiences and ideas for the game. Please understand that as a small team, we have to prioritize balancing, bug fixes and new feature implementations. But I promise we take all your feedback seriously and will get to it eventually.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44514748/00b866d8e5da2b1dafb169965474566b46dd6c9b.png[/img]

[h2]Support the game[/h2]

If you haven’t already, please wishlist The Rabbit Haul! It’s a simple way to support the game and stay updated on future playtests, announcements, and updates.

Want to be more involved? [url=https://discord.gg/SmvrWxP5jc]Join our Discord[/url] for discussions, sneak peeks, and a chance to shape the game through feature suggestions and live events.

Thank you for being part of this journey. Your feedback and enthusiasm make all the difference, and we’re excited for what’s to come in 2025!

-- Until next time! 👋

notes.title: The Rabbit Haul at Gamescom 2024!
notes.notes:
If you are attending Gamescom Germany this weekend, you'll definitely want to check out our booth for The Rabbit Haul.

Located in Hall 10.2 at booth E40, you can try the shortened demo version of the game, get a selfie with the Rabbit, and learn more about what we have going on.

In addition, we have two very cool giveaways happening at the booth:

[olist]
[*][b]Play the Game, Receive a Sprout[/b]. You can join the #SproutSquad at Gamescom by playing The Rabbit Haul. We love seeing the squad grow, so feel free to tag us and use the hashtag to show your support on socials! Subject to availability.
[*][b]Cozy Game Scavenger Hunt[/b]. We are partnered with four other cute and cozy games around Hall 10.2 for a scavenger hunt! Find each booth and show proof of game wishlist to receive a cute custom stamp, and when you get all 5, you'll be entered to win a $100USD Steam Gift Card! Limited postcards available, so grab it while you can.
[/olist]

We hope to see you this weekend at Gamescom!

notes.title: Discord Playtest & In-Game Updates August
notes.notes:
It's August, and our team is heading off to Gamescom Germany to showcase [i]The Rabbit Haul[/i]. This month is big for us in terms of updates and giving the opportunity for new people to try our game at the event and on our Discord!

[h1]Our Playtest Returns[/h1]
Get ready for an exclusive, week-long playtest during Gamescom week, August 19 - 26, 2024! We are so excited to have two unique playtests available: one being hosted at the event, where attendees will have the chance to try out new features in a shortened, 6-wave run, provide feedback, and interact with our development team.

Our other playtest, hosted on our Discord server, will be a test of the full game, including our out-of-run upgrade and unlock system. This will be an excellent opportunity for our players to give some of their final feedback on the prototype version of The Rabbit Haul, as we head into our production of the full game - do not worry if your suggestions are not yet implemented, we have everything noted and will be working on them during our production phase!

[url=https://discord.gg/UVDt2ScaDJ][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44514748/764833c3f329295ff22779aabff999d9f16b1115.png[/img][/url]

As we head into one of our final playtests of the summer, we just wanted to take a moment to say thank you to each and every one of our players, who have tested any and every iteration of The Rabbit Haul, and who have provided the most valuable feedback about all elements of the game. We spend so much time looking over your answers, reviewing what we can do better and implementing plans to make each test a unique experience. Our community is the reason we are able to do what we do, and we truly appreciate your support.

[h1]In-Game Updates[/h1]
Now to the juicy part - what’s new in The Rabbit Haul for July! We have a new crop and two new towers - one offensive and one defensive. In addition, there are language updates to note.

[h2]Watermelon Crop[/h2]
The Watermelon is a purchasable crop that has a longer growing time than most of our other crops. However, it sells for a high value, and if it's put in the haul, it will punish enemies who try to steal it.

When a raccoon picks up a Watermelon, a "heavy" effect will appear, and the enemy will be slowed while trying to exit the playing field, allowing the player extra time to attack and get back their crop!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44514748/f451150d523793eccc8f7976b0280bbfbd53bb83.jpg[/img]

[h2]Stink Bomb Tower[/h2]
Stink Bombs are our second wild encounter, after the blueberry bush that we introduced you to last month. They will appear sporadically, and can be picked up by the player to be placed where they prefer.

If an enemy walks over the Stink Bomb, they will be damaged with a chance of "poison" effect, where there will be damage applied over time. These are a one-time use tower, so be careful about when and where you use them!

[h2]Sprinklers[/h2]
We've heard you about how tedious watering can be, so we've implemented a new tower that can help speed up the process for you, and will also assist you during the night as well!

Sprinklers can be purchased at Gerald's Greens, and have 3 stages.

[list]
[*] [b]Stage 1[/b]: waters in a plus (+), affecting the crops above, below, and to the left and right.
[*] [b]Stage 2[/b]: waters all the plants around the sprinkler, including those diagonal to it; similar to the effects of the Beehive.
[*] [b]Stage 3[/b]: waters two circles surrounding the sprinkler, for a total of 24 plants watered daily!
In addition to its impressive daily properties, it will also assist you at night by spraying water at the enemies nearby and pushing them back, allowing you more time to fight and prevent them from hitting your haul.
[/list]

[h1]French In-Game Translations[/h1]
Isael has been working hard at translating The Rabbit Haul into French. It is a slow process to find every line of text and translate it accurately, so we are unsure if it will be fully implemented by the time the playtest comes out - but stay tuned!

Courtney’s Fun Fact: je ne parle pas français, mais je parle un peu japonais et coréen.

[h1]Steam Page Localized to 10 Languages![/h1]
We are very excited to update our Steam page to ten languages, allowing you to learn about The Rabbit Haul in whichever language you prefer.

These languages include: English, French, German, Spanish, Russian, Polish, Brazilian Portuguese, Japanese, Traditional Chinese, Simplified Chinese, and Korean.

Currently, these languages are just for the Steam page itself, with plans for in-game localization coming much later in our development process.

--

These are our updates from August! We hope that are able to playtest [i]The Rabbit Haul[/i] in-person or online, and have a wonderful remainder of your summer.

notes.title: June 2024 Patch Notes
notes.notes:
Welcome to our June update of The Rabbit Haul! This month, we focused on preparing for our in-person events, such as Game Con Canada and Gamescom Germany, as well as out-of-run updates that will improve replayability.

[h1]In-Person Game Demo Created[/h1]
We created a new, in-person demo version of The Rabbit Haul. This version is 6 waves long, with a tutorial quest line to introduce the various mechanics of the game to new players. During Game Con, this version of the game played around 20 minutes, with the fastest time being under 8 minutes! While parts of this demo version will make it into the final version, this iteration is meant for in-person tests only, to ensure that as many people can try the game as possible over the weekends.


[h1]New Tower & Crop[/h1]
This month, we have added in a new offensive tower, the Sniper Violet, and a wild crop, the Blueberry Bush!

[h2]Sniper Violet[/h2]
The Sniper Violet is a new offensive tower which shoots fast, hard, and at far ranges. This works perfectly in tandem with the Touch-Me-Nots which shoot bursts at short range, meaning the Trash Panda Posse won’t stand a chance! There will also be symbiotic relationships built in with this tower, working alongside other Sniper Violets to best protect your garden.

[h2]Blueberry Bush[/h2]
Foraging has become a big hobby in the last few years, and one of the best parts of exploring in games such as Stardew Valley and Story of Seasons. So we wanted to incorporate wild crops in addition to the ones you grow in your garden. The first of these crops is the Blueberry Bush, which will grow randomly in the wild, and replenish similarly to the strawberries. It has a low sell value, but will improve your haul strength and provide you much needed nourishment after a hard-fought night battle!

[h1]Backswing Combo Attack[/h1]
The first of our combo attacks is being implemented into the game, empowering your personal attack power with a bit of speed. By timing your swings just right, you’ll be able to swing, backswing, and then finish them off with an overhead slash. These combos will be locked behind the skill tree, which we will show you below.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44514748/5d0e50b2f58271e92385b3f1f8c422b4aa77a0da.gif[/img]

[h1]Skill Tree & Out-of-Run Upgrades[/h1]
We have been working the hardest on our out-of-run upgrades, which include our skill tree and unlockable items at this time. This is to give our gamers more reason to play again, with rewards being given for your hard work building up your haul and survival skills through the waves. You’ll be able to strengthen your defenses with unlockable towers and new skills, and build a bigger and better farm with new crops. As this system is complicated and time-consuming, we aren’t able to show you everything - but maybe that’s good, so we have more to show you next month!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44514748/dc68877bb82a984b5896d05523fd9a3237bfee6a.jpg[/img]

[h1]Traduction de "The Rabbit Haul" en Français[/h1]
Caldera Interactive is a bilingual studio, with fluency in both French and English. As such, we are making the first steps at translating The Rabbit Haul into French. This is the first of many languages we hope to add into the game, but those will be coming later in our development process. This translation work should be done by the end of August, so if you’ve been waiting, on y est presque.

notes.title: May 2024 Playtest: Patch Notes
notes.notes:
Hello everyone, Courtney from Caldera here with our May Playtest patch notes.

We have had a crazy few months between events and grant writing, but we are excited to finally be launching the latest version of [i]The Rabbit Haul[/i], exclusively for our Discord members to try.
Below are all the updates we have made since our previous playtest in March 2024.

[h1] Game Changes [/h1]
[list]
[*] Towers now instantly heal after the night phase ends.
[*] New inventory bar UI.
[*] Updates to the start screen artwork.
[*] New health bar UI.
[/list]

[h1] New Lose Condition [/h1]
[list]
[*] You no longer instantly lose when your haul reaches 0 crops.
[*] You lose when your haul is depleted AND raccoons have escaped with the stolen crops.
[*] You will also lose when your health bar reaches 0hp - remember to keep some crops on hand, just in case!
[*] When an enemy carrying a crop dies, it will drop what they were holding on the ground, and magnet back to your haul when you get close to the crops.
[*]  Raccoons stealing a crop are given a large speed boost as they try to escape. (The higher the wave, the faster they run away)
[/list]

[h1] New Tower: Wild Rose [/h1]
[list]
[*] The Wild Rose tower slows down enemies that walk through it and has a chance of causing a damage-over-time (DoT) effect called "Thorn"
[*] Thorn at level 1 will deal 1 damage and stun the enemy for 0.1 seconds every 1.5 seconds, for 3 total seconds.
[*] By placing a Wild Rose beside another Wild Rose, both towers will get a buff to their slow and Thorn effects. This does not work with diagonal placement.
[*] Wild Rose towers have 4 main stages - stage 4 requires purchasing it in addition to the regular watering.
[olist]
[*] Stage 1: No Abilities.
[*] Stage 2: 30% chance to apply Thorn and 100% chance to slow passing enemies.
[*] Stage 3: 40% chance to apply Thorn and 100% chance to slow passing enemies.
[*] Stage 4: 100% chance to apply Thorn and 100% chance to slow passing enemies.
[/olist]
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44514748/d84a3ad47108f64dba4a543164bcbac5b17c653a.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44514748/0b85a60c7ab9da2c5e5aea8fb05f4bb7c6bb2d52.jpg[/img]
[h1] New Sound Effects [/h1]
[list]
[*] Touch-me-Not Attack
[*] Racoons attack
[*] Rabbit taking damage
[*] Rabbit eating
[*] Rabbit heal
[*] Tower Upgrade
[/list]

[h1] Bug Fixes [/h1]
[list]
[*] Fixed the Touch-me-Not panel descriptions
[*] Player can no longer attack faster than the attack animation
[*] Fixed the stickering of sprites in inventory
[*] Fixed an issue where sometimes, carrots would fall through the ground
[*] Fixed the Raccoon Boss hitbox
[/list]

[h1] Balancing Changes [/h1]
[list]
[*] Added a 13th wave
[*] Removed slow effect from Touch-me-Not towers
[*] Buffed the Ice Wand (20 >>> 30 damage per attack)
[/list]


This playtest included a lot of major and minor updates to the game, and as this weekend's playtest continues, we look forward to hearing more feedback and suggestions on how to make [i]The Rabbit Haul[/i] the best it can be! 

If you would like to join our playtests, you can head on over to our Discord, linked on the Steam page.

Until next time,

Courtney
